trigger: User challenged whether GitHub migration actually produced Agent/Skill/Harness/control-plane product architecture instead of moving large prompts into repositories.
root_cause: Agent productization acceptance criteria were implicit. Continuity strongly validated state/evidence/leases, but did not mechanically validate separation of Skill router, executable runtime, authoritative workflow, Harness, progressive references and continuity. This allowed thin-Skill intent to coexist with fat bootstrap/Skill surfaces.

accepted_architecture.signal_plane: non-authoritative observations/events separated from authoritative single-writer state

rejected_alternatives: Require every owner to use OpenAI Agents SDK: rejected because executable Agent products may use deterministic or external runtimes.
Copy the Universal architecture validator into every owner: rejected because shared control semantics would drift across repositories.
Store current owner HEAD inside AGENT_MANIFEST: rejected because manifest writes would make their own freshness receipt stale.
Treat large Skills as automatic failure: rejected; size is architecture drift requiring refactor/justification, while missing runtime/workflow/harness is a hard failure.

drift: Skill router is approximately 20KB and exceeds the 8192-byte thin-router target; runtime/workflow/harness are real and separately declared.
owners.validation_scope: Current tree/manifest structure + current owner CI + previously observed Skill size; does not prove live prose quality or provider isolation.
